query:
SELECT 
  r.id as residentId,
  r.firstName,
  r.lastName,
  p.id as packageId,
  p.packageType,
  p.isActive,
  p.endDate
FROM residents r
LEFT JOIN packages p ON r.id = p.residentId
WHERE r.firstName = 'enka'
ORDER BY p.createdAt DESC;
